name: @quak/qasm-transform
description: OpenQASM 3 <-> circuit transformation in TypeScript, generated from the same ANTLR grammars the backend uses. Lets the VSCode extension parse and emit .qasm without a server.

scripts.generate: antlr4ng -Dlanguage=TypeScript -visitor -no-listener -Xexact-output-dir -o src/generated ../../backend/src/main/antlr/OpenQASM3Lexer.g4 ../../backend/src/main/antlr/OpenQASM3Parser.g4 && node scripts/seal-generated.mjs && node scripts/check-generated-current.mjs --write
